definitions.gloss: lucky day; auspicious day; most favorable day
definitions.explanation: The most auspicious day in the traditional Japanese six-day calendar cycle (六曜 rokuyo). Considered the best day for weddings, business openings, and other important events.

examples.japanese: ⟦{結婚式|けっこんしき}→結婚式：05493_kekkonshiki⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{大安|たいあん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{日|ひ}→日：02249_hi⟧にした。
examples.english: We held the wedding on an auspicious day.

examples.japanese: {大安|たいあん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{日|ひ}→日：02249_hi⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{結婚式場|けっこんしきじょう}→結婚式場：30785_kekkonshikijou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{予約|よやく}→予約：01522_yoyaku⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{取|と}り→取る：00565_toru⟧にくい。
examples.english: It's hard to book wedding venues on auspicious days.

examples.japanese: ⟦{新|あたら}しい→新しい：00506_atarashii⟧⟦お{店|みせ}→お店：21164_omise⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{開店日|かいてんび}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{大安|たいあん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{合|あ}わせて→合わせる：01872_awaseru⟧⟦{決|き}めた→決める：00858_kimeru⟧。
examples.english: We chose the opening day for the new shop to coincide with an auspicious day.

notes:
CULTURAL NOTE:
{大安|たいあん} is part of the ⟦{六曜|ろくよう}→六曜：29161_rokuyou⟧ (six-day cycle) calendar system used in Japan for fortune-telling. The six days are: {大安|たいあん} (most lucky), ⟦{友引|ともびき}→友引：24469_tomobiki⟧ (partly lucky), {先勝|せんしょう} (morning lucky), {先負|せんぶ} (afternoon lucky), ⟦{赤口|しゃっこう}→赤口：24761_shakkou⟧ (mostly unlucky), and ⟦{仏滅|ぶつめつ}→仏滅：16754_butsumetsu⟧ (most unlucky). Many Japanese calendars still include these designations.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {大安|たいあん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{日|ひ}→日：02249_hi⟧ (an auspicious day)
- {大安|たいあん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{合|あ}わせる→合わせる：01872_awaseru⟧ (to schedule for a lucky day)
- {大安|たいあん}{吉日|きちじつ} (auspicious and lucky day — formal set phrase)
